faq.heading: Everything you want to know about El-Qimah Learn
faq.subheading: Clear answers to the most common questions to help you start your learning journey with confidence.

one.question: How do I start learning on the platform?
one.answer: Create your account, browse the courses that fit your level, and start learning right away at your own pace.

two.question: Can I follow my progress?
two.answer: Yes. Every course shows your progress so you always know where you stand and what to study next.

three.question: Are the teachers specialized?
three.answer: All teachers are selected for their experience and ability to explain lessons clearly and in an organized way.

four.question: How are payments handled?
four.answer: You can book any course securely and get immediate access to its content once the payment is completed.

five.question: Can parents follow their children?
five.answer: Parents can follow the learning journey and see their children's progress across subjects and courses.

six.question: Is there support if I need help?
six.answer: Our support team is available to help you at every step so you can keep learning without interruption.

hero.titleLead: Elevate your learning, develop your skills, and start your journey toward achieving your goals and reaching the
hero.subtitle: Discover a complete learning experience that combines high-quality content with specialized teachers, helping you understand your lessons better, develop your skills, and achieve your academic goals with confidence through a flexible learning experience that fits your needs and supports you at every stage of your journey.

steps.title: Your journey to the summit starts with three steps
steps.subtitle: Learn in a simple, organized way and make real progress with every step.

discover.title: Discover what suits you
discover.text: Start by defining your needs and learning goals, then explore the available subjects and courses and pick what fits your academic stage. You'll find a variety of options to help you choose the right path for you.

learn.title: Learn your way
learn.text: Start learning through organized, simplified content and benefit from specialized teachers to understand lessons and build your skills. Learn at your own pace and revisit the content whenever you need.

progress.title: Move toward your goal
progress.text: Track your progress continuously and discover what you've achieved and what still needs development. With every lesson and new step, you get closer to your goals and build confidence in your abilities.

courses.title: Featured courses that help you progress
courses.subtitle: Choose from a carefully selected set of courses and start learning today.

parents.title: Be part of your children's success journey
parents.subtitle: You can follow the learning journey, see your children's progress, and support them in achieving their goals.

follow.title: Follow their progress
follow.text: Stay close to your children's learning journey and see their progress across subjects and courses, so you always know where they stand.

support.title: Support them at every step
support.text: Discover where your children need help and support them with the right resources at the right time, keeping them motivated along the way.

celebrate.title: Celebrate their achievements
celebrate.text: Follow the milestones your children reach and celebrate every achievement, building their confidence and encouraging them to keep going.

clarity.title: From learning challenges to a clearer experience
clarity.subtitle: From scattered content and hard choices to an organized learning journey that helps you reach your goals with confidence.

scattered.title: Scattered learning content
scattered.text: Students face many sources and lessons, which makes reaching the right content and organizing the learning journey more difficult.

choosing.title: Difficulty choosing the right course
choosing.text: Too many options make choosing more confusing, so it can be hard to know the most suitable course or teacher for a student's level and goals.

path.title: No clear learning path
path.text: Some students start learning different topics without knowing the next step, making it harder to track progress and reach their goals.

organized.title: Organized, easy-to-reach content
organized.text: Find the learning content and courses that suit your academic stage in one place, without moving between multiple sources.

choice.title: A choice that fits your needs
choice.text: Explore the courses, teachers, and materials suited to your level and needs, and pick what helps you achieve your learning goals.

journey.title: A clear learning journey
journey.text: Move forward with clear steps toward your goal. Organize your learning and follow steps that show what you've learned and what to learn next, so you progress with confidence.

plans.title: Flexible plans that fit your learning journey
plans.subtitle: Choose the plan that suits you and benefit from tools that help you manage your courses, reach your students, and grow your educational presence.
